args.lesson: Fresh WordPress Jobs RSS and a 5 November RSL project page provide explicit Canadian paid-project evidence (C$2,000–2,500) and a direct email application route; unlike prior agency pages this is an actual project request. However mandatory Kadence experience/portfolio and confidential shortlist materials exceed demonstrated access. A CAD79 text-only QA inquiry was saved unsent and expressly labelled adjacent/unrequested, with 2.75 planned total hours and unallocated costs; it is not qualified demand. Next prioritize exact task fit over attractive advertised budgets, without inventing WordPress delivery capability. Page visibility and the site's 21-day listing policy do not verify availability. No new sending occurred, prior authorizations remain consumed, and three unclassified sources leave feedback unknown.
